expo.name: Stargaze

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Stargaze uses the camera to show the live sky behind the star map.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Stargaze uses your location to work out which stars are above you.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Stargaze uses motion sensors to match the star map to where you point your phone.

plugins.cameraPermission: Stargaze uses the camera to show the live sky behind the star map.

expo.description: Point your iPhone at the sky and see the stars, constellations, planets, Sun and Moon above you.
